# Elliott Wave LLC Contributor Copyright Assignment Agreement

> **Under legal review.** We have contacted legal counsel to review this
> agreement, and it may change before the first outside contribution is merged.

Thank you for your interest in contributing to a project maintained by
Elliott Wave LLC (the "Company"). Elliott Wave LLC owns all intellectual
property in its projects, including the open-source ones. Open-source licences
let the public use that code; they do not transfer ownership of it. To keep
ownership in one place, every outside contribution is assigned to the Company
before it is merged.

**What this means for you, plainly:** you assign the copyright in your
Contribution to the Company. In return the Company grants you back a broad,
permanent licence, so you can still use, modify and share your own
Contribution for any purpose. Your work is credited in the project history.

You accept and agree to the following terms for Your Contributions, present and
future, that you submit to any project maintained by the Company (each a
"Project").

## 1. Definitions

**"You"** means the copyright owner, or the legal entity authorised by the
copyright owner, entering into this Agreement. For legal entities, the entity
making a Contribution and all entities that control, are controlled by, or are
under common control with it are considered a single Contributor. "Control"
means the power to direct the management of the entity, ownership of fifty
percent or more of its outstanding shares, or beneficial ownership of it.

**"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including
modifications or additions to an existing work, intentionally submitted by You
to a Project for inclusion in, or documentation of, the Project. "Submitted"
means any form of electronic, verbal, or written communication sent to the
Company or its representatives, including mailing lists, source control
systems, and issue trackers, but excluding communication conspicuously marked
by You as "Not a Contribution."

## 2. Assignment of copyright

You hereby irrevocably assign, transfer and convey to the Company all right,
title and interest worldwide in and to the copyright in Your Contributions,
including all rights to sue for past, present and future infringement.

To the extent any right in a Contribution cannot be assigned under applicable
law, You grant the Company a perpetual, worldwide, exclusive, no-charge,
royalty-free, irrevocable, transferable licence, with the right to sublicense
through multiple tiers, to exercise that right, and You waive, or agree not to
assert against the Company or its licensees, any moral rights You hold in the
Contribution.

## 3. Licence back to you

The Company grants You a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge,
royalty-free, irrevocable licence to use, reproduce, modify, publicly display,
publicly perform, sublicense and distribute Your own Contributions, for any
purpose. This licence does not extend to the rest of the Project.

## 4. Patent licence

You grant the Company and recipients of software distributed by the Company a
perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable
(except as stated in this section) patent licence to make, have made, use,
offer to sell, sell, import, and otherwise transfer the work, where that
licence applies only to those patent claims licensable by You that are
necessarily infringed by Your Contributions alone or by combination of Your
Contributions with the work to which they were submitted.

If any entity institutes patent litigation against You or any other entity —
including a cross-claim or counterclaim in a lawsuit — alleging that Your
Contribution, or the work to which You contributed, constitutes direct or
contributory patent infringement, then any patent licences granted to that
entity under this Agreement for that Contribution or work terminate as of the
date such litigation is filed.

## 5. How the Company may license the Project

**You acknowledge that the Company may license Your Contribution, as part of
the Project or otherwise, under any licence it chooses, including open-source,
source-available and commercial terms, may sell or transfer it, and may change
the licence applied to a Project in future.** This is the term that separates a
company-owned project from a foundation one; if you are not comfortable with
it, please do not sign.

The Company will not revoke an open-source licence already granted on any
released version of a Project.

## 6. Further assurances

You agree, at the Company's request and expense, to sign any further documents
reasonably needed to record or perfect the assignment in Section 2.

## 7. Your right to make this assignment

You represent that you are legally entitled to make the assignment and grant
the licences above. If your employer has rights to intellectual property that
you create that includes Your Contributions, you represent that you have
received permission to make Contributions on behalf of that employer, that
your employer has waived such rights for Your Contributions, or that your
employer has executed a separate Corporate Assignment Agreement with the
Company.

## 8. Originality

You represent that each of Your Contributions is Your original creation. You
represent that Your submissions include complete details of any third-party
licence or other restriction, including related patents and trademarks, of
which you are personally aware and which are associated with any part of Your
Contributions.

Should you wish to submit work that is not Your original creation, submit it
separately from any Contribution, identifying the complete details of its
source and of any licence or restriction of which you are personally aware, and
conspicuously mark it as "Submitted on behalf of a third-party: [named here]".
Third-party work is not assigned by this Agreement and is merged only if its
licence permits.

## 9. No support obligation, no warranty

You are not expected to provide support for Your Contributions, though you may
if you wish, for free or for a fee. Unless required by applicable law or agreed
in writing, You provide Your Contributions on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT
WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied, including
without limitation any warranties or conditions of TITLE, NON-INFRINGEMENT,
MERCHANTABILITY, or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

## 10. Notification

You agree to notify the Company of any facts or circumstances of which you
become aware that would make these representations inaccurate in any respect.

## How to sign

Comment on your pull request with exactly:

```
I have read the Copyright Assignment Agreement and I hereby sign it
```

Your GitHub username, the date and the commit are recorded in the signatures
branch. One signature covers all your future contributions to projects
maintained by Elliott Wave LLC.
